native_checks.platform_evidence: Record native platform must show x86_64 and retain actual macOS/Xcode details. Configuration must enable plugins and tests in Release; CTest runs serial with --no-tests=error.
native_checks.junit: Parse actual ctest-results.xml; count individual registered cases, passed, failed, formal skipped and disabled. Require zero failures and no unaccounted cases. Record named skip reasons and separately count nested Python unittest skips from retained output. Do not substitute prior counts.
native_checks.full_log: Retain LastTest.log and the original native job log; use them when JUnit output truncation omits assertion counts or skip reasons.

juce.rule: Require successful source-verification step and actual configured dependency version/revision matching pinned source; do not infer from CMake arguments alone.

au_payload_binding.rule: Require exactly two well-formed SHA256/path entries per record, correct source and registered-copy roles, four equal hashes across both records, and equality to the actual AU executable bytes read from the accepted downloaded installation archive. Inspect the actual successful diff-bearing steps and logs; workflow source records sign-before-copy and full recursive comparisons before validation and before packaging. Reject a missing record or unequal hash even when pluginval is green.
au_payload_binding.boundary: Recursive diff binds complete file/resource contents and presence on runner. The retained hash records separately bind the executable to downloaded bytes; this is existing ad-hoc signing only.
